findings.summary: Generation and embedding GPU errors retained hidden/past/LoRA/model state inconsistently.
findings.verification: Actual worker message handler imported with SDK and operations mocked; generate/judge/embed/load GPU failure all clear shared session state and queued next operation succeeds.

findings.summary: Missing error/messageerror event handling and synchronous failure cleanup left a failed worker referenced and waiters/timers alive.
findings.verification: Actual hook imported with React hooks and Worker mocked; fatal events, constructor/post failure, load failure, shutdown and unmount clear references and waiter timers immediately; subsequent post creates a replacement worker.

findings.summary: Initial 503/offline/invalid JSON was permanently cached as undefined until reload.
findings.verification: Actual loader with fetch mocked:503→success,offline→invalidJSON→success,successful reuse,concurrent deduplication;404/410 remain cached absent optional files.

findings.summary: A stop during awaited model loading was lost when the stopping criteria were recreated.
findings.verification: Actual generation function with SDK mocked; stopped pending load never enters model.generate; streaming stop and next request remain intact.

findings.summary: Stop could not cancel generation requests waiting behind a serialized judgment/embedding operation.
findings.verification: Actual worker handler with held embedding:enqueue generate,stop,release embedding; canceled request emits normal done/0 without calling generate; fresh next request executes.

findings.summary: Prompt shortening removed history/system only and allowed an oversized final user message into GPU execution.
findings.verification: Actual encoder/generation with deterministic fake tokenizer:1901 tokens rejected before generation,1900 accepted,latest user content retained after system/history reduction.

findings.summary: First data load awaits knowledge, then core parallel files, then translation,champion names and item names in sequence even though these requests are independent.
findings.verification: Source/call order inspected only; root is already deferring this whole feature out of the initial JS path, and no latency claim is made.

findings.summary: releaseModel clears references without explicitly disposing ONNX sessions. Local installed SDK exposes async model.dispose(); GPU recovery lifetime deserves a separate resource release review.
findings.verification: Source and installed @huggingface/transformers/src/models/modeling_utils.js:251 inspected; actual GPU memory lifetime not measured.

limitations: 170 scoped TS/TSX files received structural AST/import/export/control-flow/async/storage scans;64 received full executable-source manual review,4 selected-branch review,6 entry components were manually reviewed by root. This is not a claim that every line in all files was manually reviewed.
Pure display card runtime code was inspected after TypeScript transpilation removed types/comments and omitted literal CSS classes; root and UI reviewers own actual design/focus/browser verification.
Failure/cancellation regressions use actual application handlers/hooks with mocked SDK/Worker/React scheduling. No model weights were downloaded and no real GPU memory or throughput was measured.
Root is responsible for final integrated full tests,typecheck,lint,build and real-browser verification.
